name: Playing with an Incubus
source:
"Playing With An Incubus" is a short BL/Yaoi visual novel featuring the unexpected encounter between Alexandre, a lonely guy obsessed with his favorite gacha game, and Rodric, a hungry incubus seeking to find someone. Split between his original plans for the night and giving attention to his new visitor, what will Alexandre choose?

[From [url=https://hayashi-games.itch.io/playing-with-an-incubus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Playing With An Incubus》是一部短篇BL／Yaoi视觉小说，讲述沉迷于心爱抽卡游戏的孤独男子亚历山德，与饥肠辘辘、正在寻找对象的梦魔罗德里克意外相遇的故事。一边是原本为今晚安排好的计划，一边是需要招待的新访客，亚历山德将如何选择？

[摘自[url=https://hayashi-games.itch.io/playing-with-an-incubus]itch.io[/url]]
